# 3ngram v1.4.4

Patch: debrief writes stay one typed atom under the 2000-character cap, and the
debrief prompt can carry a project so those writes appear in a project briefing.

## Changes

- **Debrief is one typed atom per `remember`.** `SERVER_INSTRUCTIONS` and the
  `debrief` prompt tell the agent to split a longer recap rather than dump a
  session transcript. `MAX_CONTENT_LENGTH` stays 2000 — it is now a typed-atom
  budget, not the retired capture-hook latency contract. Import is unchanged
  (larger bound). This is the cheap half of issue #166; the Stop-hook trigger
  is not in this release.

- **Optional `project` on the `debrief` prompt**, completable from live facets.
  A memory written with no project never matches a project-scoped briefing.

- **Concept docs describe shipped behavior.** #164 aligned table counts, MCP
  resource status, and the 11-tool README, and added `scripts/check-docs-truth.sh`
  so those claims cannot silently rot.

## Upgrade notes

No breaking API change. Clients that already call `remember` with content over
2000 characters still get a schema 400 — they always did. Agents that follow
server instructions will split instead of retrying.
